x: Duncan, the Oxford Blue, was running for Reading, and won the 100 yards race, beating Gray, and Wiley, of our own club. Alby Bird ran away from his field in the 880 yards, and with Frank Webb and L.
Holt (7½) finished third, just beating Alby Bird, who once again qualified for a sprint final. The 440 Yds. was won by L.
D. Hills, one of our new walkers, gained his six miles in the hour badge by walking 6 miles in 57 mins. 11 secs. in the Walton A.C. trial in June.
